items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: A friend named Hannibal Marvin Peterson called me up... So he’s crashing on my floor and he immediately started working with Rahsaan Roland Kirk and Gil Evans.

ctx.x: I have some of those Howard Johnson records. They are a delight.

Oh Howard Johnson was a dear friend of mine from early on in New York. My career started in New York. I called Bob Burgess, “Can I crash on your floor” in New York. And I moved up from North Texas State, I moved to New York. And Bob went back on the road with Woody Herman pretty soon after I got there so I inherited this cheap apartment in New York City in Manhattan. A friend named Hannibal Marvin Peterson called me up one day and says, “Can I come up to New York and crash on your floor?” Hannibal Marvin Peterson…
Yes I saw him in Rochester.
